submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on non-sentence-initial content tokens from a preferred unigram class (e.g. gold, fruit, oil, good, objectives, true, clear, taste) once preceding clausal context has accumulated, with strength building over the clause; it is silent on sentence-initial or isolated tokens, on constituent-opening function words (the, and, a), and on non-preferred content tokens (snack, water, team, today, cream, cat) in identical positions.
